prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from directory listings alone. A practical next step is to speak with **two or three firms** that handle car-injury cases in the Tri-Valley and compare who would actually manage your case.

A few local options to contact include:

- **Mirador Law** — Pleasanton office; its listing specifically mentions car-accident cases. [Website](https://miradorlaw.com/pleasanton-personal-injury-lawyer/car-accident/)
- **Ginny Walia Law Offices** — lists a Pleasanton office and Bay Area car-accident representation. [Website](https://walialawfirm.com/personal-injury/car-accident-lawyer/)
- **GJEL Accident Attorneys** — has a Pleasanton car-accident page. [Website](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton)
- **Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch** — Pleasanton office and personal-injury practice. [Website](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/)

These are starting points, not endorsements; firm websites and directories are not independent proof of results or quality. Before hiring, check the specific attorney’s status and public discipline history through the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch), and ask each firm:

1. Who will handle my case day to day, and how often will I hear from them?
2. Have you handled cases like mine, including similar injuries or disputed fault?
3. What is the contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe if there’s no recovery?
4. What are the strengths, risks, and likely next steps in my case?

Bring the crash report, photos, insurance details, and medical records to consultations if you have them. Don’t sign with a firm just because it promises a particular settlement. If you’re seriously injured or an insurer is asking for a recorded statement or release, consider getting legal advice promptly.
